pipelines.name: Integration tests

steps.name: Start Zabbix environment
steps.run:
docker compose -f "devenv/${DEVENV}/docker-compose.yml" up -d
# Wait for Zabbix to be ready
sleep 30
# The bootstrap container is a one-shot job that imports the host
# config and creates the per-user auth test user. Block until it
# exits, surface its logs, and fail fast if it failed — otherwise
# tests that depend on the provisioned data pass or skip silently.
cid=$(docker compose -f "devenv/${DEVENV}/docker-compose.yml" ps -aq bootstrap)
bootstrap_exit=$(docker wait "$cid")
echo "--- bootstrap logs ---"
docker logs "$cid"
if [ "$bootstrap_exit" -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "bootstrap exited with code $bootstrap_exit"
  exit 1
fi

steps.name: Run integration tests
steps.run:
# Each version's test self-gates on its own INTEGRATION_TESTNN var.
export "${INTEGRATION_VAR}=true"
go test -v ./pkg/zabbixapi/...
